name: aegis-of-the-mad-king
description: An open-world roguelike of many continents, warring nations, and one shield that must break.
author: Ishmam Haque

scripts.prepare-game: node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.mkdirSync('app',{recursive:true});for(const f of ['index.html','icon.svg','manifest.webmanifest'])fs.copyFileSync('../'+f,'app/'+f);fs.mkdirSync('app/fonts',{recursive:true});for(const f of fs.readdirSync('../fonts'))fs.copyFileSync('../fonts/'+f,'app/fonts/'+f);fs.mkdirSync('app/icons',{recursive:true});for(const f of fs.readdirSync('../icons'))fs.copyFileSync('../icons/'+f,'app/icons/'+f)"
